note: Provenance for the Cinema Room's delivered art (COOP-001 ticket 36). The raw generations live in the main checkout's .scratch/COOP-001-apartment/art/generated/32-cinema-room/ (gitignored) and travel here only as sha256s; each source.path is the kept attempt ticket 32's manifest names and its 2026-09-25 approval confirms (S02 attempt-v3-nocat, S22 and S24 attempt-v3-painted). Every file rebuilds byte for byte from that source with the builtBy line. Beats keep the design note's frame proportions at the source's own resolution (pxPerUnit), never upscaled past it. Since ticket 79 the three shelves and their three caps-gone stills come from ticket 77's closing run instead (77-cinema-shelf-wall/, each attempt-1, accepted 2026-09-26); each caps-gone entry names the shelf it is a variant of and the measured pixel diff between the two. Since ticket 92 the Room stands on a 1360 x 765 stage (design 75 section 4.4): backdrop.png is ticket 91's outpaint (91-cinema-outpaint/s02-region-edit/attempt-1) and door-leaf.png ticket 90's leaf (90-cinema-door-leaf/S03-door-leaf/attempt-2), both accepted 2026-09-26; every other entry records the factor it is drawn at on that stage in "stage92"; spindles.png (S11) came off the stage with ticket 71's fold-in; the two seated stills are cut from S26's and S27's last frames, with no generation.
